project: AquaMind AI - Autonomous Desalination Operations Agent

disclosure.description: Canonical source-grounded reasoning cases. They are not real plant incidents and do not by themselves constitute model training data.
disclosure.runtime_note: Cases marked runtime_supported map to current deterministic capabilities. knowledge_grounded cases require further runtime integration before claiming direct diagnostic support. safety_policy cases define expected guard behavior.

cases.title: Stable normalized operation
observed_patterns: No sustained abnormal directional change after normalization
reasoning_basis: Normal operation should not be converted into a fault diagnosis.
cases.inference_note: Normal operation is a no-actionable-anomaly outcome, not evidence that every component is healthy.

cases.title: Temperature-driven apparent performance change
observed_patterns: Raw permeate flow or salt passage changes
reasoning_basis: Operating-condition changes can alter apparent membrane performance before normalization.
cases.inference_note: The case is a source-grounded hypothesis pattern, not proof of root cause.
